holiday_plan.intro: A four-day Thanksgiving weekend requires Friday, November 27, off; confirm your own employer's holiday and weekend schedule. These four options stay within roughly a three-hour normal-traffic driving radius of NYC, with Longwood near the outer edge. Holiday traffic can take substantially longer. Philadelphia is the strongest car-free overnight; Cold Spring is the simplest nature-focused day trip. Beacon/Dia and Storm King were considered but replaced because their official pages were blocked and holiday access could not be verified.

trips.title: Cold Spring village and a daylight riverside walk
trips.why: Combine the village waterfront and Main Street with an optional walk at Little Stony Point for Hudson Highlands scenery without planning a summit hike. Choose November 27–29 if shops and lunch are important, but verify individual businesses' hours.
trips.transport: Car-free: Metro-North Hudson Line from Grand Central to Cold Spring, then walk. Do not rely on the seasonal Cold Spring trolley: MTA lists service only through Veterans Day.
trips.time_budget: Allow a full day, with the outdoor portion completed before sunset; select outbound and return trains for your actual travel date.
trips.booking_note: MTA has published a November 26-only Hudson Line holiday timetable; do not apply it to the whole weekend. Check official trail maps and closures before adding Little Stony Point. Breakneck Ridge and its station are closed for construction and should not be substituted into this itinerary.

trips.title: Hudson overnight with Olana's new contemporary-art exhibition
trips.destination: Hudson and Olana State Historic Site, New York
trips.why: Spend November 28–29 pairing Hudson's downtown dining and shops with Frederic Church's designed landscape. Newly opened Laurent Grasso installations introduce contemporary film and painting into Olana's historic interiors, giving this familiar escape a timely reason to visit.
trips.transport: Car-required for this suggested itinerary: drive to Hudson and Olana. Amtrak plus a prearranged taxi is an alternative, but Olana explicitly warns of limited taxis and rideshare availability; it is not a walk-from-the-station attraction.
trips.time_budget: One night and two days. Olana publishes an estimated 2.5-hour drive from NYC, before holiday delays.
trips.booking_note: Olana currently lists tours Saturday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–3:30 p.m., and the Frederic Church Center Saturday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m. Grounds are listed as open daily until sunset. Reserve the appropriate house/exhibition admission for November 28 or 29; neither tour inventory nor lodging availability was checked. Confirm restaurant hours separately.
trips.event_name: Metaphysical Maze: Laurent Grasso at Frederic Church's Olana and the Thomas Cole Site

trips.title: Philadelphia Christmas Village, food and an art-museum overnight
trips.why: A November 28–29 stay combines the German-style Christmas Village at LOVE Park and City Hall with the Philadelphia Museum of Art's Marcel Duchamp exhibition. This offers a food-and-culture trip with an indoor component rather than relying entirely on outdoor conditions.
trips.transport: Car-free: NJ TRANSIT Northeast Corridor from New York Penn Station to Trenton, then SEPTA's Trenton Line to Center City. The operators require separate fares. Walk and use local transit in Philadelphia. Direct Amtrak is another option, but its official page was blocked during this research.
trips.time_budget: One night and two days; allow substantial travel time for the Trenton transfer rather than treating this as a quick out-and-back.
trips.booking_note: Christmas Village confirms November 26 hours of 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; Friday–Saturday noon–9 p.m.; Sunday noon–8 p.m. General market admission is free, with purchases and attractions separate. The museum lists regular Saturday–Sunday hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; confirm date-specific admission before booking. NJ TRANSIT's holiday guide did not yet show Thanksgiving arrangements.

trips.title: Longwood's cosmic-themed Christmas gardens
trips.why: The 2026 display combines illuminated outdoor gardens with conservatory installations inspired by stars and astronomy. It is a distinctive holiday outing with both indoor and outdoor elements, and a confirmed operating season covering all four planning dates.
trips.transport: Car-required for the proposed self-drive itinerary. Longwood also lists direct OurBus service from NYC, but departures for November 26–29 were not verified; only treat that as a car-free alternative after confirming both directions.
trips.time_budget: A long day extending into the evening. Longwood recommends 3.5–4 hours in the gardens and lists NYC as 130 miles away. This is near the outer edge of the requested driving radius, not a guaranteed three-hour holiday journey.
trips.booking_note: The event page lists daily hours of 10 a.m.–11 p.m. during the season. Buy a dated timed-entry ticket only after settling transportation; admission inventory was not checked. Longwood permits entry within 30 minutes before or after the ticket time, except early admission for the first slot. OurBus tickets, if used, do not include garden admission.

local_ideas.title: NYBG Holiday Train Show after dark
local_ideas.why: Botanical replicas of NYC landmarks and model trains make an art-and-garden alternative to leaving town. NYBG explicitly schedules extended evenings on all three dates: the Conservatory stays open until 8 p.m., with last entry at 7:15 p.m. and live music programming. Reserve exhibition admission; the NYC-resident Grounds Access Pass does not include the Conservatory or special exhibitions.

local_ideas.title: Bryant Park Winter Village shops and skating
local_ideas.why: Combine holiday shopping and food with a reserved skating session. The official 2026 season covers the weekend. Skating admission is free, but rentals and other services cost extra; own-skate reservations are released one week ahead. The tree lighting is December 1, outside this window.

dining.intro: NYC dining options for November 12, 2026: lunch values, recent openings, seasonal menus and Thanksgiving meals. Holiday ordering deadlines and unconfirmed details are noted.
dining.michelin_note: No Michelin award claims are retained or added. The reviewed evidence does not establish current Michelin status for these candidates; Michelin's own listings were not checked. Editorial recommendations, guide selection and Michelin stars must not be treated as interchangeable.

items.title: Dynamo's $35.95 express lunch and daily bar happy hour
items.summary: The express lunch includes rolls, a salad choice and spaghetti pomodoro or salmon. Happy hour offers oysters, smaller martinis and snacks near Penn Station.
items.price_text: Express lunch $35.95; steak frites supplement $10. Happy-hour oysters: 3/$9.95, 6/$18.95 or 12/$36.95; Miller High Life $6.95; wine $12.95; mini dirty martini $11.95.
items.schedule: Lunch 11:30am–2:30pm, Monday–Thursday according to current operating hours. Happy hour daily 4–6pm.
items.conditions: Happy hour is restricted to the bar or terrace. Friday–Sunday opening is 4pm, so lunch should not be assumed available then. Reservation requirements, tax, gratuity and holiday exceptions are not stated.
items.verification_note: The official location page explicitly confirms Monday–Thursday lunch, 11:30am–2:30pm: https://www.thedynamoroom.com/location/the-dynamo-room/. Prices and bar/terrace-only happy-hour restrictions are supported by https://v4-thedynamoroom.getbento.com/menus/. Regular hours do not establish holiday availability.

items.title: Amélie's $26 weekday lunch and daily oyster happy hour
items.summary: A $26 two-course weekday lunch and daily oyster happy hour offer separate ways to visit. The happy-hour menu also lists a $26 burger-and-fries or moules-frites offer with beer or wine.
items.price_text: Two-course lunch $26; lunch wine of the day +$10. Happy-hour oysters $1.50 each; six oysters with a glass of wine $19; selected cocktails $10; beer $7; three-wine flight $14. Early bird: burger and fries or moules frites with beer or wine, $26.
items.schedule: Lunch Monday–Friday noon–3:30pm. Happy-hour food daily 4–6pm; drinks from opening until 6pm.
items.conditions: Lunch excludes tax and gratuity; burger supplement $5, steak frites or Niçoise supplement $8. The lunch page specifies two courses despite displaying three course sections. Happy-hour oyster minimum, mandatory reservations and tax/gratuity treatment are unstated. Early-bird offer appears on the happy-hour menu without a separate time window.
items.verification_note: Lunch price, supplements, exclusions and hours verified at https://ameliewinebar.com/wv/menus/bistro; happy-hour prices and timing verified from captured official text at https://ameliewinebar.com/wv/menus/happy-hour. The lunch page says two courses despite displaying appetizer, entree and dessert sections; do not promise all three.

items.title: Junoon's two- or three-course Indian lunch
items.summary: The Prestige Prix lunch includes basmati rice and naan, with vegetarian, seafood and meat choices such as eggplant chaat, mushroom xacutti and chicken gassi.
items.price_text: Two courses $43; three courses $49.
items.schedule: Lunch; exact days and hours unknown.
items.conditions: The menu states a 20% service charge for parties of five or more in its dinner footer; applicability to lunch was not separately clarified. Tax treatment and mandatory booking are unknown.
items.verification_note: Read the official lunch menu and linked location page. Location hours did not render usefully, so no lunch schedule or holiday availability is inferred.

items.title: Anton's $14 weekday pasta lunch
items.summary: The Fall 2026 luncheon menu lists six $14 pastas, including angel hair Francese, spaghetti anchoiade and ricotta cavatelli alla Norma.
items.price_text: $14 per listed luncheon pasta.
items.schedule: Weekdays 11am–3pm.
items.conditions: Weekday lunch pricing, not a dated special-menu event. Walk-in space is held. Tax, gratuity and minimum purchases are unstated. Do not assume the $14 pasta offer applies on Thanksgiving, for which a separate holiday menu is published.
items.verification_note: Fall 2026 luncheon prices and 11am–3pm weekday timing are explicit at https://www.antonsnyc.com/menus/. The separate holiday menu is dated November 26, 2026: https://media-cdn.getbento.com/accounts/36ae7752e94ab282ecee1043de81b5d2/media/3r22rVfLRnuirS5LFpAF_Anton-s%20West%20Village%20Thanksgiving%202026.pdf.

items.title: Miss Lily's $25 brunch drinks add-on
items.summary: Weekend brunch offers unlimited selected drinks with a signature dish purchase, including rum punch and a One Love Bellini.
items.price_text: $25 per person for the drinks add-on, plus a signature dish; examples include $18 coconut pancakes, $20 Jamaican chilaquiles and $23 Jamaican breakfast.
items.schedule: Saturday and Sunday noon–4pm.
items.conditions: A signature dish purchase is required; $25 is the drinks add-on, not the meal total. The linked dinner PDF states that 18% gratuity is automatically added and further tips are optional; its application to brunch is not separately confirmed. Brunch duration, whole-table participation, tax and other fees remain unverified.
items.verification_note: Brunch prices and the required signature dish are supported by https://v1-misslilys.getbento.com/east-village-7a/; weekend noon–4pm hours by https://www.misslilys.com/location/miss-lilys-east-village-7a/. The legible gratuity footer appears in https://media-cdn.getbento.com/accounts/6bf634e39aedd8f498d9be9ee3d04ff7/media/wv4HBvbDQpCdrAAAn56L_ML7A_Dinner%20Oct-5-2026.pdf; much of that PDF's remaining extraction is garbled.

items.title: Canton Harbor's $14–17 weekday lunch specials
items.summary: Eater's November Queens guide reports weekday lunch specials with soup and rice, including beef stew with radish and chicken with cashews.
items.price_text: $14–17, including soup and rice, as reported by Eater.
items.schedule: Weekday lunch; exact special-menu hours unknown.
items.conditions: Prices and inclusions are reported by Eater, not independently confirmed against a current restaurant menu. Exact lunch-special hours, booking requirements, tax, gratuity and holiday exceptions are unverified.
items.verification_note: The November 4 report explicitly lists $14–17 weekday lunch entrees with soup and rice: https://ny.eater.com/maps/best-new-queens-restaurants-heatmap. The restaurant's opening date and opening-week operating conditions were not independently established in this review.

items.title: Delmonico's Thanksgiving three-course dinner
items.summary: An explicitly dated Thanksgiving 2026 menu offers three courses at the historic Financial District restaurant.
items.price_text: $150 per person, excluding beverages and tax; 20% gratuity added to every check.
items.schedule: Thanksgiving Day, November 26, 11am–9pm.
items.conditions: Official booking is offered, but remaining availability was not verified. The linked booking URL contains an older year in its slug, so it is not presented as a verified 2026 reservation link.
items.verification_note: The official event explicitly states 2026, service hours, price, exclusions and automatic gratuity. Thanksgiving service is advertised rather than inferred from regular hours.

items.title: Bubby's Thanksgiving takeout for two
items.summary: A two-person package includes turkey, glazed ham, sides, biscuits and pie slices, supplied cold with reheating instructions.
items.price_text: $200 for two; lasagna add-on $18.
items.schedule: Thanksgiving pickup November 26, 10am–2pm.
items.conditions: No substitutions or modifications. Order deadline, remaining inventory, tax, gratuity and pickup fees are unknown. The kitchen warns about allergen cross-contamination.
items.verification_note: Official menu supplies package price, pickup hours and restrictions; The Infatuation's 2026 Thanksgiving guide supplies the year/date context. Checked the official Tribeca location page. No order was placed.

items.title: Anton's $95 Thanksgiving sides package
items.summary: A sides package for four includes a stuffing choice, whipped potatoes, chopped spinach and quince-cranberry sauce. Turkey is not included.
items.price_text: $95 for sides serving four; pies $75 each, serving eight; cookies $32 per dozen.
items.schedule: Order by November 20 at 5pm; pickup November 24 or 25.
items.conditions: Advance ordering required. Heating instructions included. Exact pickup hours, taxes, gratuity, fees and remaining availability are unknown.
items.verification_note: Read the official package, order cutoff and pickup dates. start/end represent pickup dates, not the ordering window. The order form was not submitted.

items.title: Edy's Lebanese Thanksgiving feast
items.summary: The reported six-to-eight-person feast includes sumac turkey, fig stuffing and tahini apple pie.
items.price_text: $480, serving six to eight, as reported by The Infatuation.
items.schedule: Orders close November 20; reported pickup November 23 or 24.
items.conditions: Advance preorder required. Official ordering content did not render sufficiently to verify inventory, pickup hours, taxes, fees or substitutions. Price and pickup dates remain editorially sourced.
items.verification_note: The $480 price, six-to-eight servings and November 23–24 pickup dates are supported by https://www.theinfatuation.com/new-york/guides/thanksgiving-dinner-nyc and independently corroborated by the November 10 report at https://ny.eater.com/maps/best-thanksgiving-takeout-nyc-holiday-orders-turkey-dinners. https://edysgrocer.com/ confirms the Thanksgiving promotion and November 20 cutoff. Image filenames are not date evidence.

items.title: Alexia Duchêne's French-inspired menu at La Compagnie Flatiron
items.summary: Consulting chef Alexia Duchêne's collaboration brings French-inspired seasonal dishes to La Compagnie Flatiron's wine-bar menu.
items.schedule: Venue hours: Monday–Wednesday 5pm–midnight; Thursday–Saturday 5pm–1am; Sunday 5–11pm. Kitchen cutoff unknown.
items.conditions: This is an ongoing chef-menu launch, not a one-night pop-up or discount. Exact food prices, minimum spend, tax, gratuity and holiday exceptions were not established. Reservations are offered.
items.verification_note: https://www.experimentalgroup.com/new-york/la-compagnie-flatiron confirms the collaboration, address and hours, and advertises a Sunday, November 8 launch without printing a year. The claimed dated Eater corroboration was not established in the reviewed evidence, so the exact launch year is unset. This card covers Flatiron only; other restaurant identities would not be duplicates merely because they share the collaboration.

items.title: Brasserie Boulud's October arrival near Lincoln Center
items.summary: Daniel Boulud's new brasserie combines the former Bar Boulud, Boulud Sud and Épicerie operation near Lincoln Center, with French classics and a broad à la carte menu.
items.price_text: Official menu examples: classic burger $25, trout $30, coq au vin $36, half rotisserie chicken $39.
items.schedule: Tuesday–Sunday 4:30–10:30pm.
items.conditions: Reservations are offered; availability, taxes, gratuity and holiday exceptions are unknown. Preopening coverage discussed additional dayparts, but the current official site lists dinner hours only.
items.verification_note: October opening is corroborated by https://ny.eater.com/maps/best-new-nyc-restaurants-heatmap; the October 2 announcement described October 8 as planned, not independently verified first service. Current dinner hours are explicit at https://www.brasserieboulud.com/, and all four quoted dish prices are confirmed at https://www.brasserieboulud.com/our-menu/daily-menu.

items.title: One Bryant Park's Japanese harvest tasting menus
items.summary: The October newcomer serves seasonal Japanese tasting menus under culinary director Tadaaki Ishizaki. Its current menu is themed around the Niinamesai harvest celebration.
items.price_text: Eleven-course tasting $265; five-course selection $175. Listed lobster substitutions add $26 or $22 respectively; selection-menu abalone option +$38.
items.conditions: Seasonal dishes can change. Reservations are offered; tax, gratuity, service charges, operating hours and holiday availability were not established. This does not imply the separately planned Kappo Sono is open.
items.verification_note: https://ny.eater.com/maps/best-new-nyc-restaurants-heatmap reports an October opening but no exact day. https://www.onebryantparknyc.com/menu explicitly confirms the $175 five-course and $265 eleven-course menus and supplements. This card also retains the menu information duplicated in candidate 24; no opening of Kappo Sono is inferred.

items.title: Creola's seasonal Black-diaspora tasting menu

items.price_text: Eater reports $125 for the tasting menu and an optional $65 wine pairing.
items.schedule: Wednesday–Saturday; exact seating times unknown.
items.conditions: The official page confirms the format and days but does not expose current prices or booking terms. Tax, gratuity, service charges and holiday availability are unknown.
items.verification_note: September opening and the reported $125 menu/$65 pairing are supported by https://ny.eater.com/maps/best-new-nyc-restaurants-heatmap. https://www.creolanyc.com/ confirms five courses and Wednesday–Saturday service, but not current prices.

items.verification_note: An October opening is explicitly reported at https://ny.eater.com/maps/best-new-restaurants-brooklyn-heatmap. https://altbaubakery.com/ confirms Wednesday–Sunday, 9am until sellout; no exact opening day is inferred.

items.title: Āzar's announced November 7 Persian street-grill debut

items.price_text: Reported opening-menu prices: ghormeh sabzi beef-cheek wrap $12; koobideh wrap $12; chicken fesenjoon or eggplant kashk bademjoon wrap $9; tahchin $8; drinks $5.
items.schedule: Reported Wednesday–Sunday noon–9pm.
items.conditions: Opening was announced for November 7, but the official page still displayed the announcement. Actual operation and current prices were not independently confirmed; verify before a dedicated trip. Tax, gratuity and holiday hours are unknown.

items.title: Delphine Brasserie opened October 29 at the Ace Hotel
items.summary: The new French brasserie offers daily breakfast and a more limited dinner schedule, with reported dinner dishes including steak au poivre and chicken for two.
items.schedule: Breakfast daily 7–11am; dinner Wednesday–Saturday 5–10pm.
items.conditions: Reservations are offered. Dinner is not advertised seven days a week. Menu prices, tax, gratuity and holiday exceptions are unknown.
items.verification_note: Eater explicitly supplies the October 29 opening date. Official website confirms the address, booking link and separate breakfast/dinner schedules.

items.title: Mili opened November 4 on Ludlow Street
items.summary: Jorge Luis Pabón and Alexis White's new restaurant pairs seasonal cooking with a domestic-focused wine list; reported dishes include sunchoke tart and scallops with Manhattan chowder.
items.conditions: Current prices, hours, booking requirements and holiday availability are unverified.
items.verification_note: https://ny.eater.com/maps/nyc-new-restaurant-openings-2026 explicitly reports the November 4 opening, address, owners and described dishes. The official website was not independently rechecked in this final pass.

items.schedule: Thursday–Monday 5–11pm.
items.conditions: Prices, reservation requirements, tax, gratuity and holiday exceptions are unknown. Regular service is not advertised Tuesday or Wednesday.
items.verification_note: September opening and culinary background are supported by https://ny.eater.com/maps/best-new-restaurants-brooklyn-heatmap. https://148noblestreet.com/ lists Thursday–Monday, 5–11 service; an exact opening day is not established.

items.title: Maison Mekong's flaming pho and Southeast Asian cooking
items.summary: This Astoria restaurant serves flaming bone-marrow pho, duck curry and crispy pig ears with papaya and peanuts.
items.conditions: Opening date, current prices, service hours, booking requirements and holiday availability are unverified. No happy-hour prices are claimed.
items.verification_note: Restaurant-specific dishes and address are supported by https://ny.eater.com/maps/best-new-queens-restaurants-heatmap. November heatmap inclusion does not establish a recent opening, so this is classified as restaurant rather than opening.

items.summary: A four-course Thanksgiving menu served for the table includes black-truffle turkey roulade, beef tenderloin, four sides and dessert.
items.price_text: $90 per person
items.schedule: Thursday, November 26; holiday seating times not stated
items.conditions: Official page directs guests to reserve on Resy. Minimum party size, children's pricing, tax, gratuity, service charges and cancellation terms are not stated. Regular Wednesday–Saturday dinner hours are 5–10pm, but holiday hours were not separately confirmed.

items.title: Amélie's $49 three-course prix fixe requires whole-table participation
items.summary: Choose an appetizer, main and dessert; options include escargots, coq au vin, ravioles and crème brûlée.
items.price_text: $49 for three courses; steak frites +$8
items.schedule: Prix-fixe service days and hours are not specified
items.conditions: Entire table must select the prix fixe. Tax and gratuity explicitly excluded. Optional upgrades carry additional charges, including truffle fries +$5 and black truffle on ravioles +$6. Reservations offered; requirement and holiday exceptions not stated.
items.verification_note: Read the complete HTML prix-fixe menu and official location/contact information. This is separate from the previously found $26 weekday lunch.

items.title: Amélie's $25 November Beaujolais flight
items.summary: A dedicated seasonal menu offers a flight of Fleurie, Morgon and Brouilly. The restaurant describes a month-long celebration using vintage Beaujolais rather than a one-day Nouveau dinner.

items.schedule: Menu states All November; specific service hours not stated
items.conditions: Flight pour sizes, food minimum, tax, gratuity and service charges are not specified. The page does not print a year, so precise start/end dates remain unset. Current availability should be confirmed.

items.title: Pig Beach's $295 Thanksgiving feast must be collected November 25
items.summary: The feast serves 10–12 with smoked turkey or turkey breast, gravy, cranberry sauce, sides and a choice of pie. This is reheating-ready takeout, not Thanksgiving restaurant dining.
items.price_text: $295 for the Thanksgiving Full Feast serving 10–12
items.schedule: Order by November 22 at 8pm; pickup November 25, noon–9pm, according to Eater
items.conditions: Preorder required. Official website confirms November 25 pickup and explicitly says the restaurant is CLOSED on Thanksgiving Day, November 26. Tax, gratuity, service charges and remaining stock were not verified; ordering portal was not readable.

Dedicated festival page returned HTTP 403. Configuration places this outdoor series in June–August, outside the November window; no summer programming inferred.

Official double-bill page verifies three November 12–14 performances, doors, address and accessibility. Ticketspice did not expose prices.

Followed the old address to elsewhere.club and checked dated event pages plus Eventbrite details. Nine retained events. Door times remain separate from unverified artist starts; Omni's conflicting description date is flagged.

Official page verifies Hollywood Meets Bollywood, including the 7pm dance lesson, 8pm concert and general-public prices.
Official events page returned HTTP 403.
Official anniversary page verifies November 15, 7–11pm, named artists and advance/door prices; homepage corroborates the Woodward Avenue address.

Read the venue's dated lineups. Retained the 718 Sessions anniversary; venue text confirms November 15 and the artists, but not hours, price or age policy.

Read arts listings and the November concerts article. Six retained items preserve provenance: The Bad Plus and five DURATIONS sessions. Waitlisted or unverified mary in the junkyard listings were not retained.
Organizer and Eventbrite pages verify two St. Michael's concerts and Monday's five-piano program. These are three performances within one 17-concert centennial festival, not three distinct festivals.
Official event page verifies Eden Girma at MITU580, free RSVP and the actual off-site venue.
Followed the official site to ATG; event pages verify tripleS and Lil' Kim, including doors, show times and Lil' Kim's formal-attire requirement. Prices remain unknown.
Official calendar and event pages verified nine retained concerts/parties: six at LPR and three at National Sawdust, Littlefield and The Town Hall. Show times were distinguished from doors.
Official page verifies the November 14 Luis Vargas/Monchy concert. Ticketmaster returned 403; price and availability are unknown. Conflicting VIP-reception times were not used.
Official calendar and event pages verified Luisito Gomez & Calle 107 and Cynthia Erivo. The benefit's ticket price could not be recovered and is explicitly flagged as potentially over budget.
Official event pages verified CopyFest, Soca & Friends and RNB vs Slow Jams; the Holly Miranda/Melissa Ferrick concert was additionally verified through presenter LPR.
Official calendar rendered a Showing 0 Events shell rather than reliable inventory. Editorial arena leads were not treated as independently verified recommendations.
Calendar read; in-window listings were exhibitions rather than music. November 19 School Nite is outside the window. Warm Up is out of season.
Official shows page did not expose its dynamic listings. A sold-out November 18 lead was not retained.
Assigned performances page exposed only footer/contact material. Diles que no me maten was independently verified through official presenter LPR and its venue-specific ticket link.
Official page verifies Joanna Kotze's November 12, 13 and 14 performances, ticket floor and Thursday post-show conversation.
Public page loaded navigation and subscription information but no current dated newsletter; no retained lead.

Private-address, TBA and independently unverified leads were excluded. Official sources corrected Terre Thaemlitz's performance time and Playback's even…

Public address geocoding supplied venue coordinates where ticket pages lacked them. Other coordinates came from organizer-linked ticket-page map data. Lehman uses the published campus-address pin.
HTTP 403 prevented calendar coverage.

Events page returned HTTP 403.
Assigned calendar redirected to an image-heavy homepage without usable dated text in the inspected output. Four sessions were independently verified through the DURATIONS organizer's DICE links.
Inspected official homepage, but the returned content did not provide a usable event schedule.
City listings and an attempted individual Good Room ticket page returned HTTP 403. Good Room's anniversary lineup was verified directly with the venue; its hours and prices remain unknown.
Official pages verify Terre Thaemlitz and Qasim Naqvi, including distinct doors and performance times.
Homepage exposed a SHOWS heading without usable dated inventory. The Tuesday Youth Code/Final Gasp lead was not independently verified.

Read the returned city listings and a Tuesday-specific listing with 44 entries, including duplicates and non-NYC results. Three retained items preserve provenance: The Pharcyde/Slum Village, Phillip Phillips and John Scofield. November Variations and Youth Code leads lacked sufficient official veri…
Inspected the Staten Island venue's upcoming listing. In-window offerings were a film and holiday vendor market; the next listed concert was November 19, outside the window.
Dedicated page returned HTTP 403. Configured season ends in September; no November event inferred.
Calendar redirected to a shows page that remained at Loading; usable listings were not exposed.

Official calendar and date-specific pages verified Jihee Heo on Monday and Hector Martignon and Duduka Da Fonseca on Tuesday. Separate sets of the same band are consolidated rather than counted as extra events.
Repeated HTTP 307 redirects prevented access to the performance calendar.

Read the current November 10–12 roundup. Fewer than 20 plausible in-window music leads were published. Elizabeth Bougerol at Joe's Pub was investigated, but official verification returned 403; no Skint-derived event retained.
HTTP calendar and admission page worked despite an HTTPS transport failure. Four retained performances; official policy confirms 8:30pm music and $20 cash-only door admission unless otherwise noted.

Organizer's Eventbrite page verifies Wednesday 6–9pm programming and Melaner's first/third-Wednesday assignment. Food/drinks are separate and RSVP does not reserve seating.

Read the full weekly guide and followed music leads to organizers. Four retained events preserve provenance: three Django bills and Bourbon & Brass. The latter uses organizer hours rather than conflicting editorial hours.

Sixteen date-confirmed entries use date-only ISO start values because only doors or the calendar date could be verified. No door time was promoted to an invented performance start; applicable hours are preserved in doors_at and time_note.

Official schedule and FAQ verify the orchestra's Monday engagement, New Masada Quartet's November 17–22 run, set/seating times and one-drink minimum. Ticket pages were dynamic; cover prices remain unknown.
